newsitem.title: UK: BRADFORD WOOL CAUTIOUS ON BUYING INTEREST.
newsitem.headline: BRADFORD WOOL CAUTIOUS ON BUYING INTEREST.

text.p: Holidays again subdued the markets but some districts and countries were returning to work which revived the need for deliveries, even if not much of a revival in buying interest was seen.

Bradford was aware of reports that China had raised thee annual quota and reduced tariffs. Increased buying interest is likely and was even put forward as a reason for a firmer Australian market late last week.
Locally the demand side is seen as better but the attitude is to treat reports with caution and await saleroom developments.
